methods.label: Count the equal clock intervals
methods.explanation:
At seven o’clock, the minute hand points to \(12\) and the hour hand points to \(7\). The twelve equally spaced hour marks divide a full turn into angles of
\[
360^\circ\div12=30^\circ.
\]
From \(7\) through \(8,9,10,11\) to \(12\) there are five intervals; the other direction has seven. Thus the smaller angle is \(5\times30^\circ=150^\circ\), choice D.
methods.levelReason: Counting equal gaps and dividing a full turn require only elementary angle measurement and arithmetic.
